# Fixture provenance

A `Format=Anthropic` native ingress on `model-based-routing` def 1.0.5 / impl 1.0.9 with two routes and a fallback (#1404). Unlike the def 1.0.4 `anthropic_inbound/` captures, the routing headers are returned. The Bedrock route answers a text/plain 404. Pinned by `tests/unit/test_model_routing_1_0_5_contract.py`; see docs/verified-apis.md §2.

- `messages.success`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): bare claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 on the anthropic route; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.prefixed`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): anthropic/-prefixed model; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.bedrock_404`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): bedrockanthropic/ prefix, cross-vendor to the Bedrock route; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.unresolvable`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): unresolvable bare model; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.fallback`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): unconfigured openai/ prefix, policy fallback; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.invalid_json`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): truncated (invalid) JSON body; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
- `messages.stream`: 2026-11-03, ddk-anthropic-multi-vendor (instance 21271486, native Anthropic ingress, routes anthropic + bedrockanthropic, fallback Route A): stream=true on the anthropic route; captured by Claude Code at the maintainer's request with the shared ddk-test-client pair.
